title: Owl Hooter Whistle (5-part)
description: Large low-pitch fipple whistle with a sliding tuning piston and a cute owl-face end cap (ear tufts, eye rings, beak). For soft hoots.
use: Nature-study / hobby accessory and toy; use lawfully.
material: PETG/PLA 0.16 mm. Rubber band seal on piston.
assembly: 1. Press the fipple plug into the mouth end, flat windway side toward the window.
2. Fit a thin rubber band in the piston groove, slide the piston in from the far end.
3. Thread the rod through the owl cap and press the cap onto the body.
4. Blow softly with lips sealed on the plug; slide the rod for different hoot pitches.
fit_notes: Joint clearances: press-fit joints are modelled with 0.10 mm radial clearance (0.20 mm on diameter); sliding joints 0.25 mm radial. If a press-fit is loose wrap one turn of PTFE (plumber) tape or a dab of glue; if tight, sand lightly - do not force. Not tested by test-printing or acoustic measurement. Sound depends on your printer, filament, reed film and fit - expect to tune.
fit_check: parts built in assembled pose and boolean-intersected pairwise: no interference found
